verdict.rationale: Multi-runtime execution is documented: the default `vercel/sandbox/universal` image ships Node.js LTS and Python 3.14, sandboxes can boot any Linux distribution or custom OCI image, and the SDK/CLI runs commands in blocking or detached mode with streamed logs. The "rich results" half is not evidenced: results come back only as command output, logs, and files, with no structured outputs such as charts, images, or dataframes. missing for 10: rich or structured result types (charts, images, dataframes, a code-interpreter-style API), documented per-language execution helpers beyond shell commands, independent or hands-on corroboration.
